name: Meridian Weekend Tank — Racerback Cut
description: Slim racerback tank in deep teal with a slightly longer back hem, made from moisture-wicking synth-jersey. Simple, clean, no branding. The kind of item that appears in every tier because the cut is universally flattering and the price is reasonable enough to own in multiples.
functionality: Moisture-wicking fabric handles humid lake summers; racerback cut leaves chrome shoulder ports fully exposed.
what_it_says: You're practical, unassuming, and probably own four of these in different colors.
story_hooks: Velex's basics line is manufactured in a Tier 1 factory under contract — workers there recognize the label with complicated feelings.
The teal dye lot from this season is slightly off — collectors of a certain underground aesthetic are hunting the 'mistake' run.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist racerback tank with athletic proportions and a subtle asymmetrical silhouette. The longer back hem creates an understated visual interest without ornamentation. Reads as effortlessly modern and accessible across all tiers.
physical_description.fit: Slim but not restrictive; the racerback design sits close to the shoulders and chest while allowing natural arm movement. The longer back hem adds a slight A-line taper without bulk.
physical_description.primary_material: Moisture-wicking synth-jersey — a blended synthetic with micro-texture for breathability and durability. Soft to touch, engineered for both climate control and longevity.
physical_description.texture: Smooth with a subtle matte finish; fine ribbed texture visible only on close inspection. Light sheen under direct light, no pilling or distress in new condition.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep teal — a blue-green hybrid that sits between aquamarine and petrol. Rich enough to read as intentional, neutral enough to pair with most palettes. No patterns or accents.
physical_description.closures: None — pullover design with bound armholes and neckline.
distinctive_features: Racerback construction with minimal shoulder seaming
Asymmetrical hem — approximately 2cm longer at back
No visible branding or labels on exterior
Bound edges rather than rolled hems for durability
Flatlock stitching at seams for comfort against skin
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 accessible luxury — affordable basics that function across all social strata without signaling extreme wealth or deprivation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate minimalists, street athletes, medical techs on break, and anyone who values practical elegance. No subcultural coding; genuinely universal.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; breaks in beautifully with slight color deepening after wear. Resists visible wear patterns due to material quality.
